ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels in the central and border regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches on the distal halves of both lobes; dense black pigmentation in the central region extending to the peduncle; mottled transitional borders with high-contrast speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a measured internal pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (2-4 pixels) with more pronounced, irregular jagged indentations near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curve along the trailing edge from the median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized white circular clusters (5-10 pixels) visible at the distal tips and scattered along the leading edge transition.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting across the white pigmentation fields on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks across the ventral surface; irregular, jagged erosion of the fluke tips suggesting previous trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent dark circular focal spot located in the upper-left quadrant of the white region on the left lobe.
